rv.q: I should be inured to the way this show tugs shamelessly but unsentimentally (for Dickens) on the heartstrings, but every time it gets me.
Matthew Warchus's production looks a little under-loved this year, as if going through the festive motions rather than feeling them deeply and profoundly.
This exceptional version of A Christmas Carol remains a magical festive experience.
Much of Thorne's playwriting really is appalling. The text is so Simple Simon it grates.
